process.title: A simple, transparent process — no surprises.

step1.title: Discovery call (15 min)
step1.text: We talk by phone at the time that suits you. You present your project, your needs, your budget. No commitment.

step2.title: Tailored proposal (24h)
step2.text: You receive a detailed quote and a mockup of your future site / app within 24h. Everything is explained clearly, without technical jargon.

step3.title: Development (1-8 weeks)
step3.text: We code your project with real-time access to progress. You validate each step by email, no useless meetings.

step4.title: Launch and onboarding (1h)
step4.text: Live. We review together, hand over access, and provide support for at least 3 months. Updates within 48 business hours.

tarifs.title: Pricing
tarifs.intro: I work on a time-and-materials basis (day rate from €300/day depending on the assignment and its length) or on a fixed price for a defined scope. Written proposal within 48h after a first conversation.
tarifs.point1: Agency subcontracting: adjusted rate for recurring engagements
tarifs.point2: Fixed price: scope, price and deadline agreed before starting
tarifs.point3: No surprises: everything is confirmed in writing before work begins.

apropos.title: Independent freelance developer in Lyon
apropos.intro1: I’m Alain Rabie, a freelance developer based in Villeurbanne. I design and build mobile apps (React Native, Expo) and web apps (Next.js) in strict TypeScript, with Supabase and Stripe/RevenueCat in production.
apropos.intro2: I work as a subcontractor for web agencies and as an extra pair of hands for startup engineering teams, in Lyon or remotely.

pillar1.title: Lyon, direct
pillar1.text: Based in Villeurbanne (69100). No middleman, no offshore: you talk directly to the developer writing the code.

pillar2.title: Strict TypeScript
pillar2.text: React Native / Expo for mobile, Next.js for web. Strict TypeScript, Supabase, Stripe and RevenueCat in production.

pillar3.title: All the way to the stores
pillar3.text: From architecture to release: EAS builds, App Store and Google Play submission, update follow-up.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.q1: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faq.a1: Yes: your tools, your processes, NDA if needed; your client only ever sees you.
faq.a2: In Lyon and its metropolitan area for occasional on-site work; remote for the rest of France.
faq.a3: You do. Full transfer of rights on final payment, repository handed over.
faq.a4: Written scoping, milestones, acceptance testing, release — with a progress update at least once a week.
faq.a5: React Native / Expo, Next.js, strict TypeScript, Supabase, Stripe / RevenueCat. I don’t take on assignments outside that scope.
faq.a6: A 30-minute conversation, a written proposal, a deposit, and development begins.
